dedupe_keys.name: input data for thames et al climate sensitivity of agricultural water demand

description: Alexander Thames at Pennsylvania State University publishes climate inputs for an agricultural-water-demand study in the Colorado portion of the Upper Colorado River Basin. The December 2025 deposit provides NOAA station observations and regionally downscaled CMIP6 projections in separate ZIP archives, free under CC BY 4.0. The associated EGU 2026 abstract describes a multisite copula-based weather generator coupled with a regional consumptive-use model. These input collections can support reproduction or comparison of irrigation-demand sensitivity experiments. Station identities, observation periods, climate-model members, units and downscaling details remain unknown from the repository summary. They must be checked before constructing new scenarios. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this prepared input collection. The separately deposited synthetic outputs are derived scenarios, not the original observations. File contents, processing assumptions and projection uncertainty were not independently assessed.
